egress.terms: 'Unlimited Traffic*'. The asterisk resolves to: 'Incoming traffic is unlimited and unmetered. No extra charges apply. To ensure fair network performance for all customers, traffic usage must align with typical server workloads. If usage is exceptionally high or disruptive, Contabo reserves the right to throttle servers at its own discretion.' Port is 600 Mbit on this tier. No published egress overage rate. Throttling, not billing, is the enforcement.

extras.price_verbatim: $13.44/TB/mo (Storage VPS 30). $17.60/TB (VPS 10 at $5.28/300GB). $17.14/TB (VPS 50). Every tier is 4–8× the Hetzner equivalent — the 'unlimited traffic' is real but the storage price is not competitive at any tier.
extras.agent_focus: Cheapest per-TB-month storage VPS and Storage Boxes in Europe. Price floor hunt with egress as the deciding term. Tiers recorded at 1TB/5TB/10TB/20TB. Excludes AWS/Azure/GCP/Alibaba/R2/B2/iDrive e2 per client instruction.

binding_note: the SSD of one plan is at most 1.4 TB (Storage VPS 50), so a 10 TiB set needs several plans, each at its own price
